d: S.T.A.R. — An independent project by Andrea Cavazzini, Italy. Not a company.
Every package as an installable file, as source and, where possible, as a single .py file. Built from the published code; fingerprints below and in SHA256SUMS.txt.
An independent check of a defined calculation, with a written scope and a report you can rerun.
Numbers you can check: which implementations were compared, on which cases, within which tolerance — and where to rerun them.
Three ways to use S.T.A.R. software. Pick the one that fits you; none of them needs an account, and only the third needs GitHub.

S.T.A.R. builds independent engineering software, compares it with other implementations and turns computational results into reproducible evidence — starting with orbits, time, frames and spacecraft telemetry.

70 open-source packages for orbits, time, frames, geodesy, attitude, telemetry and numerics. Each one: a fixed version, its tests, a comparison with independent libraries, and its limits written down.
